in_sanskrit.name: विश्त
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: वि (vi) - in, श्त (shtha) - to remain or stay; विश्त (vishta) - to remain, to be present

in_hindi.meaning: विष्ट (vishta) - to remain, to be present + अ (a) - not
in_hindi.long_meaning: अवि (avi) - not, विष्ट (vishta) - to remain, to be present; अविष्ठ (avishta) - not remaining, not present

in_marathi.name: Avishta
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Desire, Aim, Wish
in_marathi.long_meaning: Avishta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Avishta is derived from the Sanskrit root 'vishta' meaning 'desire, aim, or wish'. It is believed that a child named Avishta will have strong desires and determination, and will strive to achieve their goals with dedication and hard work.
